rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go — forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Section 5's body prose reads: 'When Claude gets to the bug screen, push back if it dumps all four criteria at once. One bug at a time, then the next.' This narrates a conditional failure mode, not a mandatory scripted count — it fires only if Claude actually dumps all four. The corrective action itself is a fenced prompt ({{prompt:ae101-prework-one-at-a-time}}, rendered as 'Use the AskUserQuestion tool for speeding up screening and making suggestions. One candidate at a time.'). This matches rule 16's own carve-out verbatim: 'mandatory teaching prompts stay fenced; optional push-backs... can live in body.' The primary screening move ({{prompt:ae101-prework-screen-and-ready}}) is itself fully fenced. Harm the rule guards against (a forcing function that only 'happens' if the student notices it in prose, with no fenced enactment) is absent — the enactment IS fenced; the body only narrates when to reach for it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room. Body does NOT author conversations.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grepped the full body (source and expanded view) for room-management tells: no 'discuss with the person next to you', no 'share with your neighbor', no 'tell the room', no authored pause cue. Every sentence in prework is about the WORK (pick a repo, open a session, download a tarball, pick a bug) — none is about pacing or comparing with peers. The closest candidate is 'The opening question at Module 1... Bring one' (Bring to Module 1 section) — this names a question the student brings TO M1's room beat, it does not itself author a room conversation inside prework's own text; the actual room-harvest happens in getting-going.md's Connections opener, outside this file's scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named; mood lands per phase (8+/10 teaching beats, 7 = facilitator-premium, <7 = REVISE); mood-floor carve-out for setup/launch beats.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Trace (curriculum/evals/sim-cache/ae101--module--prework.persona.json) correctly classifies 8 of 9 phases as SETUP/LAUNCH (mood_score: null — repo pick, session open, tarball fetch, extract+install, pre-read pointer, closing hand-off) and exactly 1 as TEACHING (phase 7, 'Pick a trivial bug and confirm M1 readiness'). Teaching-beat mood scores across the 3-persona triangle: mid_layer_competent 8, opinionated_senior 7, fast_operator 7. Close-scores: 8, 7, 7. No beat scores below 7 anywhere in the trace — mood floor holds. The two 7s are facilitator-premium signatures per the rule's own carve-out language, not REVISEs; each carries a named 'what would take it to 8' in its mood_note (opinionated_senior: soften 'push back if' to 'if you want it'; fast_operator: fold the recognize-the-pattern move into the fenced prompt so it fires even on a clean Claude run).

Closing section reads: 'Come to Module 1 without one and you'll be scrambling for one... Your call.' and 'Doesn't have to be big. No trick? Bring a moment Claude Code frustrated you.' Both frame absence-of-preparation as a live open question ('your call', an acceptable fallback exists), never as fault or shame. Step 5's 'push back if it dumps all four criteria at once' names Claude's likely failure mode, not the student's — the student is coached to correct the agent, not blamed for a mistake of their own.

teaching_moment_lands.verdict_note: The sole teaching beat (Step 5, bug screening + push-back rehearsal) lands reliably for 2 of 3 personas (mid_layer_competent, opinionated_senior — both read the body-prose warning and the fenced escape-hatch fires as designed). The fast_operator persona's trace explicitly flags it as fragile under a body-skipping read: the rehearsal only fires if BOTH the body sentence is read AND Claude happens to dump all four criteria in one message on that run — neither condition is forced by the prompt fence itself. This is not scored as a REVISE (mood floor still met at 7, artifact still complete under all three reads) but is a genuine fragility the trace's under_scaffolded_phases explicitly names.
